pick.what: AI notetaker for Zoom, Meet and Teams
pick.why: Free unlimited recordings + transcripts + instant summaries across all three platforms your buyers use
pick.free_limits: Free: unlimited recordings/transcripts, instant summaries; Premium USD 16/mo annual

alts.name: Granola
alts.what: Bot-free notetaker that captures device audio
alts.why: No bot joins the call, which suits sensitive/healthcare prospects; free keeps 30 days of history; Business USD 14/mo
alts.windows_fit: unclear (Windows not listed on pricing page)

candidates.verdict: Use for calls you host on Meet

candidates.name: tl;dv

decision: Fathom covers Zoom/Teams/Meet for free. Use Gemini when you host on Meet, and Granola when a prospect objects to bots. Always announce recording, and never record PHI-bearing calls without a BAA.
note: Consolidated: same pick as the Productivity track. Use Meetily (local, botless) for healthcare or PHI calls.

verify.note: Fathom Free confirmed: unlimited recordings, transcription, storage and instant AI summaries (no stated cap); Premium USD 20 monthly / USD 16 annual. Granola alt confirmed (30-day history, Business USD 14). Granola Windows app still unconfirmed.
